message.content: {"rules":["For non-zero-sized T, raw must point to memory allocated by the global allocator.","For non-zero-sized T, the allocation pointed to by raw must have layout Layout::for_value(&*raw).","raw must be non-null and sufficiently aligned for T, including when T is zero-sized.","raw must point to a valid value of T.","Calling Box::from_raw(raw) transfers ownership of raw to the resulting Box; the caller must not use repeated calls on the same raw pointer to cause a double-free.","For non-zero-sized T, a raw pointer allocated with the global allocator using Layout::for_value(&*raw) and pointing to a valid value of T may be converted into a Box<T> using Box::from_raw(raw)."]}
